name: Mars two
description: The Mars College 2026 campus in the new engine, built from the library (core/mars-* defs any god can place): Mimos and the Chiba kitchen and dining hall laid out as Gene corrected them (the L-shaped Mimos with the raised main and the glazed tea room, the outdoor gap, the kitchen west of the diner with its perimeter counters, sinks and prep table, the two northeast shower bays), Chiba with the auditorium, the Dojo, Tool camp, the Freeside compound, the west rack building, and every van, bus, trailer, toilet and hut where the reference (sim.mars.college, 2026) has them. Furniture is the reference's own: Souls sit on the sofas, chairs, stools and bus seats and put things on the tables and counters.

state.constitution:
# Mars two
The Mars College 2026 campus on the low Sonoran desert by the Salton Sea: Mimos (the café and lounge), the Chiba kitchen and dining hall, the Chiba auditorium, the Dojo, Tool camp and the Freeside compound.

Rebuilt in the new engine from the 2026 reference with Gene's Mimos and kitchen corrections.

batches.note: A real campus swimming pond with a graded shore; common physical fixture in both semantic test arms.
the campus buildings (Mimos, the Chiba kitchen and dining hall, the showers as Gene corrected them; Chiba, Dojo, Tool camp, Freeside, the west racks)

Mimos furniture: the coffee counter (#1), the tea table (#2), the study table (#3) and its chairs (#4–7), the papasan (#8), the tea stools (#9–11), the red sofa (#12), the honey sofa beneath the posters (#13), the cream recliner (#14)
the kitchen and dining hall: perimeter counters with the sinks, the prep table (#15), the fridges and freezer (#18, #19, #29), the bus seats (#20–25) and blue tables (#26–28)
Chiba and the field: the auditorium sofas, folding chairs, tier cushions, the presenter box, the classroom table and desk; the field chairs and the teal sofa

the rest of the furnished campus: Freeside (open-mic room, lime sofa, spool tables, hydro cart), CoLab (taupe sofa, drawer coffee table, floor lamp), the Tool library and workshop, OG (clubhouse sofa and table, the east dinner table and chairs, the kitchen)
things to carry: the prep mixing bowls and stock pot, the tea kettle and cups, the study mugs
the site: vans, buses, trailers, RVs, toilets, huts, the forklift, OG
the land: the playa, the tyre ring of the old race track west of camp, tyre tracks, creosote scrub; beyond the edge the 111, the wash, the salt flats, the Salton Sea and the mountains

def.name: mars-fidelity-mimos
def.description: Mimos, the 2026 Mars College café and lounge as Gene corrected it (true compass): an L of Mimos main (the west longitudinal bay; its northern sections a raised wooden floor at 0.53 m with the coffee counter and the MIMOS sign on the west wall and the study table at the north wall, its southern section at ground level, the lounge before the glazing) and Mimos floor, the south-east tea room with flooring throughout, the honey sofa beneath the posters on its north wall and the low tea table near the glazing. The sloping plexiglass with its brown drape fronts both on the south; the pallet racks between main and floor are pass-through; the north-east of the L is outdoors. Door at the glazing's west end; three risers from main south up to the raised floor. 3 rooms, 38 wall/solid colliders, 1 stairs. 4378 triangles. Licence: Mars College (Gene Kogan); campus CAD and the 2026 photographic recipe; private to this project. Source: the Mars 2026 campus as the corrected sim.mars.college source draws it (mars-src-fix a5376c1: release 43 + Gene's Oct 10 corrections in true compass). Cosmetic correction (2026-10-15): 2 native recipe image nodes has the source TextureLoader orientation restored by a V correction; original pixels, geometry and physical layout retained. The brown glazing cloth has a sagged upper edge and diagonal gathers up to 9 cm outward, fitted to drone f040/f117; its whole-building envelope and physical footprint are retained.

about.title: Mars College
about.what: A desert campus for shared study, art, making and communal life. Chiba hosts presentations; Mimos offers café, study and tea spaces; the kitchen, workshops and living compounds support everyday activity.
about.tour: Begin with Chiba for an auditorium presentation or gallery visit, Mimos for coffee and a seated conversation, or the campus kitchen for the dining hall. Tool Camp combines workbenches and a reading corner; Freeside and CoLab form the living and workshop compound. The Dojo is for practice and movement. For a swim choose the Campus Swimming Pond, not the storage tank. The old tire track is an outdoor landmark beyond the main buildings.

batches.note: Keep the four named Chiba tier cushions on their existing supported treads, clear of the central stair landings and static solids; preserve all seat definitions and capability identities.
